caption: The drawing features a square tile with a circular scene in the center, bordered at the corners with small floral motifs. Inside the circle, there are three figures: two standing on the left, dressed in long garments, and one sitting or possibly kneeling on the right, with a helmet or headdress and holding a weapon resembling a spear or staff. The background includes architectural elements such as arches, columns, and a window, indicating the setting is indoors or within a courtyard. Below the scene, there is an inscription reading "ACTO 12. V." The color palette consists mainly of shades of reddish-brown or sepia on a cream or light beige background, giving the image a monochromatic appearance. The tile design is centered on a larger, blank background.
title: Fireplace Tile
